snippet_primary: "Collections allow your customers to buy your products based on categories easily. You might have a particular group of products that naturally fit together, and it could make a lot of sense to display them as a collection on your store page, making shopping easier for your customers."
subject_exact: Payhip help documentation describes Collections feature: allows grouping related products into categories displayed on the store page; enables category-based browsing for customers
